title: Silver Mini Lot Size and Price: What One 5 kg MCX Lot Is Worth
summary: The MCX Silver Mini lot size is 5 kg. See the price of one lot, tick value, margin, expiry months, delivery rules and Silver Mini options.
body_markdown:
**The MCX Silver Mini lot size is 5 kg.** Silver Mini is priced per kg, so every ₹1 move in the price changes the value of one lot by ₹5.


Silver Mini (symbol SILVERM) is one-sixth the size of the standard 30 kg Silver contract. It is also the smallest MCX silver contract that comes with options, so many traders pick it when they want silver exposure without a large margin.

## How to Work Out the Price of One Silver Mini Lot


The value of one lot is easy to work out:


**Lot value = silver price per kg × 5**


Say silver trades at ₹1,50,000 per kg. This is an example price, not a live quote.


-


One Silver Mini lot is worth ₹1,50,000 × 5 = ₹7,50,000.


-


If silver rises by ₹1,000 per kg, a buyer gains ₹5,000 on one lot, and a seller loses the same amount.


Silver Mini's price changes through the day, so use the live futures price on your broker app or the MCX website to get today's lot value.


You don't pay the full ₹7,50,000 to trade one lot. You pay margin, which is a share of the contract value. MCX sets the minimum, your broker may add to it, and it goes up when silver gets more volatile.


For example, if the margin is 15% of contract value, one lot would need about ₹1,12,500. The 15% is only a sample figure, and our guide on[how MCX margin is set](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-margin/) explains what goes into the real number.

## Silver Mini Options


Silver Mini options have the same 5 kg lot size as the futures. Premiums are quoted per kg, so you multiply the premium by 5 to get the cost of one lot.


-


In late November, the 149000 Silver Mini call traded at ₹11,100 per kg, so one lot cost ₹11,100 × 5 = ₹55,500.


-


If you buy an option, the premium you pay is the most you can lose on that trade. For this call, that was ₹55,500.


-


[In-the-money](https://algotest.in/blog/itm-atm-otm/) options held to expiry turn into Silver Mini futures, which come with delivery obligations near expiry. Close or roll them before then if you don't want delivery.


Silver Mini options expire every month, so the option expiry is often different from the futures expiry. Check the date in the option chain before you trade, and[read the MCX option chain](https://algotest.in/blog/how-to-read-mcx-option-chain/) for open interest and implied volatility before you pick a strike.

## Silver Mini Expiry, Delivery and Trading Hours


-


Silver Mini futures expire on the last calendar day of February, April, June, August and November. If that day is a holiday, expiry moves to the working day before.


-


Silver Mini is settled by compulsory delivery. The delivery tender period covers the last five trading days of the contract, including expiry day.


-


If you don't want to take or give delivery, exit before the tender period starts, or check when your broker will[square off](https://algotest.in/blog/what-is-square-off-in-trading/) open positions.


-


Trading runs Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM or 11:55 PM, depending on US daylight saving time.


For exact dates, see our list of[MCX expiry dates](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-expiry-dates/) . Our[MCX trading time](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-trading-time/) guide covers the sessions in more detail.

## FAQs About Silver Mini Lot Size


#### What is the price of 1 lot of Silver Mini?


The price of one lot is the silver price per kg × 5. At ₹1,50,000 per kg, one Silver Mini lot is worth ₹7,50,000, but you only pay the margin to trade it, not the full value.


#### What is the lot size of Silver Mini on MCX?


One lot of Silver Mini (SILVERM) is 5 kg. Prices are quoted per kg, so a ₹1 move changes the value of one lot by ₹5.


#### What is the price of 1 lot of Silver Mini?


The price of one lot is the silver price per kg × 5. At ₹1,80,000 per kg, one Silver Mini lot is worth ₹9,00,000, but you only pay the margin to trade it, not the full value.


#### How much money do I need to trade 1 lot of Silver Mini?


You need the margin, not the full contract value. Margin is a share of the contract value and changes with volatility, so check a margin calculator on the day you trade.


#### How many Silver Mini lots equal one Silver lot?


Six. One standard Silver lot is 30 kg, and one Silver Mini lot is 5 kg.


#### When does Silver Mini expire?


Silver Mini expires on the last calendar day of February, April, June, August and November. If that day is a holiday, it expires on the working day before.


#### Can I trade Silver Mini options on AlgoTest?


Yes. AlgoTest supports both Silver Mini futures and options, and one option lot covers 5 kg.


#### Is Silver Mini cash settled?


No. Silver Mini is settled by compulsory delivery, so exit before the delivery tender period if you don't want to take or give delivery.
